g.text: C44/C45: >=4.7 uF combined effective + separate HF bypass; capacitance held.

g.text: U2 pins 1 and 9 both connect to ground. Thermal pad is not the sole return.

g.desc: U2 pins 1 and 9 both connect to ground. Thermal pad is not the sole return.

g.text: C48 supplies VCC only. C3 connects BOOT to SW; old 51-ohm resistor removed.

g.desc: C48 supplies VCC only. C3 connects BOOT to SW; old 51-ohm resistor removed.

g.text: EN tied to VIN_BUCK: always-on cell, no battery discharge cutoff implemented.
